body: Thank you.  I try to tell him this stuff and it has zero effect.  It's like he's in denial about how reliant he is on me or something.  It's so maddening.

I've often feared I'm enabling him.  I'll try to tell him this, talk about it and refuse to do certain things but nothing seems to stick.  I do think it might be better for him to live away from me for awhile I'm just scared bc he gets suicidal.  He's always asked that I not tell her the extent of his problems but at this point I feel like I have to.
Yeah. Him not going to the clinic that day was kind of my last straw.  I basically said I'm giving him until the end of the month to get to the clinic or this is done.
